candidate_definition.cutoff_rule: Historical captured producer rule: greatest configured cutoff no later than wall clock and no later than the candidate latest observation minute; wall cutoff if no cutoff is eligible.
candidate_definition.fallback_rule: When the candidate has no cutoff-eligible WU row, retain that snapshot's captured served high_so_far; no non-WU input is changed.
candidate_definition.kind: deterministic point-in-time payload-observable candidate; no fitted parameter
candidate_definition.name: point_in_time_wu_observable_tail_recovery_v2
candidate_definition.payload_rule: At capture t, trust every row in the current payload. Recover a previously published missing row only when the current payload contains no row at or after that row's target-date-local minute. If the current payload is empty, every previously published target-date row is eligible for recovery.
candidate_definition.point_in_time_rule: At snapshot t, use the current replay payload and only replay snapshots with captured_at_utc strictly earlier than t. Emit a nonblank current-snapshot receipt, assert every recovered-row source is strictly earlier, and consume nothing after t.
candidate_definition.replay_change_scope: Replace only the captured WU history row series with the point-in-time envelope and let the captured model path recompute cutoff_hour, high_so_far, downstream features, and probabilities. All other captured inputs, model identity, calibration, floor, and probability-mass rules remain unchanged.
candidate_definition.same_timestamp_rule: A current row at the same minute is at-or-after evidence, so the current vendor value replaces every prior value for that minute.
